candidates.label: commentCount

candidates.label: adverseOutcome

candidates.label: seriousAdverseOutcome

candidates.label: children

candidates.label: source

candidates.label: interactingDrug

Distinct from contraindication, which typically refers to a disease or condition that makes a drug unsuitable.

candidates.label: causeOf
candidates.comment: A causal relation between a medical cause and the medical entity (condition, complication, symptom) it produces. Also called "results in", "leads to", "produces". Examples: "Influenza virus medical causeOf Flu", "Smoking medical causeOf Lung cancer". Distinct from cause, which describes what leads to a condition, whereas causeOf describes what a medical cause leads to.

candidates.label: previousStartDate

candidates.label: sportsActivityLocation
candidates.comment: A specific location relation between an exercise action and the sports activity venue where it took place. candidates.label: endDate

candidates.label: endTime
candidates.comment: An end time relation between an item (such as an action, reservation, or media object) and the time it is expected to conclude or when a clip ends. Also called "conclusion time", "finish time", "closing time". Examples: "Reservation 'Dinner' endTime '20:00'", "Action 'Meeting' endTime '17:00'", "Media clip endTime '00:02:30'". Distinct from endDate, which specifies the end date for longer-term items like events or seasons.

candidates.label: coverageEndTime

Examples: "Software License" expires "2024-12-31", "News Article" expires "2023-10-30T23:59:59", "Professional Certification" expires "2025-06-01".

candidates.label: pageEnd
candidates.comment: The page number or identifier where a work (article, chapter, etc.) concludes. Also called ending page, last page, final page number. candidates.label: startDate
candidates.comment: A temporal marker indicating the beginning date and time of an item, such as an event, program, or season. Also called "beginning date", "commencement date", "start time", "effective date". Examples: "The event has startDate 2023-10-26", "The program's startDate is September 1st", "This role's startDate was last Monday.". candidates.label: ownedThrough

candidates.label: validUntil

candidates.label: contentReferenceTime
